_note: Drop your sprite sheet into sprites/ as spritesheet.png, then run: python sprite_slicer.py
_coords: x/y = top-left corner of the crop region in the sheet. w/h = crop size. target_w/target_h = final size used by the GUI.
_adjust: Open spritesheet.png in an image editor, hover over each element to read pixel coordinates, then update the values below.

title_bar._desc: Full-width title banner at the very top of the sheet

panel_status._desc: Ornate panel on the RIGHT side of the header (next to the logo) — contains the status rows

btn_start._desc: Green START button (first in the button row)

gem_green._desc: Green gem — top-left corner of title bar

gem_red._desc: Red gem — top-right corner of title bar
